Stock market news | India growth outlook lifts on lower oil and foreign inflows

Lower oil prices and a comeback of foreign investors were reported on 24 November 2026. These developments ease cost pressures and bring fresh capital into Indian markets.

Economists say the combination strengthens India's growth outlook, supporting a more positive economic trajectory.
